rule.benchmark: savings rate paid (2026: 3.7%; after: 3.8%) per calendar day held
rule.capital: 1 + margin x h at entry, margin 1/3
rule.coin_price: Binance close of the hour ending at the stock close: spot where listed, else the perp (the study's convention); a variant marks the hedge leg on the perp's own close
rule.costs: stock per side by trailing-60-session dollar volume (>= $100M 5bp, $10-100M 10bp, $1-10M 30bp, < $1M 100bp) at entry and at exit; perp 5bp per side on h at entry
rule.entry: the first regular-session close (16:00 New York; 13:00 on early-close days) strictly after registration
rule.funding: Binance funding settled in (previous close, close], received by the short when positive
rule.hedge: beta, the study's main DAT hedge: h = coin value / (coin value + cash - debt - preferred), capped at 3, from the holdings and capital structure frozen at registration and the coin price at each close; rebalanced at every close (dat_forward)
rule.horizons: the 20th and 60th NYSE session after the entry close (the study's +20d/+60d are trading-day rows)
rule.kill: once all four candidate horizons are scored: mean +60-session excess over the placebo basket not positive
rule.nav_ratio: true mNAV = price / look-through NAV per share on the frozen holdings and capital structure; EMPD also with its $65M AI commitment at zero
rule.not_applied: the study's DAT exits (coins sold for anything but buybacks; 3 months) are not applied: +60 sessions is the 3 months, and coin sales are recorded as notes
rule.placebo: equal-weight basket of the other discounted DATs of the live table with a Binance coin perp and no dated catalyst (SKYA, HYPD, HSDT, NAKA, FWDI), the same rule each; MSTR as the sector benchmark
rule.position: long $1 of the stock at the entry close; short h x $1 of the coin on its Binance USD-M perp
rule.promote: both candidates above the savings rate and above the placebo basket at +60 sessions, and both true mNAV ratios higher than at entry: then pre-register the next dated-catalyst DATs (n = 2 is an anecdote, not a book entry)
rule.study: research/2026-10-10/nav_wrappers (findings.md, Next 1; live table of the 2026-10-09 close)
